summary: It is easier to say what you actually feel when you stop spending half the conversation defending your right to feel it.
body: It is easier to say what you actually feel when you stop spending half the conversation defending your right to feel it. When the Moon sextiles Mercury, emotion and language fall into alignment, letting you lay out what bothered you, what shifted, or what you require without turning a baseline truth into an argument you have to win. You don't need absolute consensus to state your reality. Name what happened clearly enough to give the exchange somewhere real to go.
